title: Understanding and Mitigating Under-Confidence in GNNs from the Final Layer
abstract: arXiv:2505.11335v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness on graph-based tasks. However, their predictive confidence is often miscalibrated, typically exhibiting under-confidence, which harms the reliability of their decisions. Existing calibration methods for GNNs normally introduce additional calibration components, which fail to capture the intrinsic relationship between the model and the prediction confidence, resulting in limited theoretical guarantees and increased computational overhead. To address this issue, we propose a simple yet efficient graph calibration method. We establish a unified theoretical framework revealing that model confidence is jointly governed by class-centroid-level and node-level calibration at the final layer. translated_title: 从最后一层理解并缓解图神经网络的置信度不足问题
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）在基于图的任务上已经展现出卓越的有效性。然而，它们的预测置信度往往校准不佳，通常表现为置信度不足，这损害了其决策的可靠性。现有的GNN校准方法通常会引入额外的校准组件，这些组件未能捕捉模型与预测置信度之间的内在关系，导致理论保证有限且计算开销增加。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种简单而高效的图校准方法。我们建立了一个统一的理论框架，揭示了模型置信度在最后一层由类中心层面和节点层面的校准共同决定。基于这一洞察，我们从理论上证明，减少最后一层参数的权重衰减可以通过作用于类中心层面来缓解GNN的置信度不足问题，同时……
tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的理论框架，揭示GNN的置信度不足由最后一层的类中心层面和节点层面校准共同决定，并从理论上证明减少最后一层参数的权重衰减可从类中心层面缓解置信度不足问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a unified theoretical framework revealing that GNN under-confidence is jointly governed by class-centroid-level and node-level calibration at the final layer, and theoretically demonstrates that reducing the weight decay of final-layer parameters alleviates under-confidence at the class-centroid level.
